propositions: The shutdown lifespan drains only the webhook queue via queue.join() and does not wait for in-flight reconciler reviews, causing them to be cancelled within ~10 seconds when the queue empties.

Any container stop outside the autodeploy path (manual restart, reboot, rollback) kills an active reconciler review with no drain protection because the drain budget is not applied to reconciler work.

The drain must prevent new reconciler reviews from starting during shutdown while waiting for in-flight reviews to complete within the existing shutdown_drain_seconds budget, bounded by a single shared deadline.

The shutdown stop flag must be cleared after the bounded cancellation phase completes, not at startup, to prevent subsequent reconcile_once calls in the same process from silently declining all candidates.
